name: Jeremy Clockson
source:
An intelligent man, gifted in the elaboration and construction of all sorts of complex mechanisms.
The horrors he experienced made him a cynical and somewhat disillusioned man, but he retained his values and remained deeply human.

Brief information:
Symbol: Clock
Best quality: Sense of humor
Worst quality: Self-esteem
Main fear: Captivity
The most important thing in life: Life itself
Flower: Amaryllis
Musical instrument: Guitar

"Since when was human life ceased to have any value? Or it just never had..."

[From in-game character profile]
